Name: Chameleon Light Polarisation Shield
Details: The Chameleon Light Polarization Shield (also called the Chameleon LPS or CLPS) is a BattleMech stealth system developed by the Terran Hegemony in 2630 alongside the Null-Signature System. Though incapable of 'true' invisibility, the CLPS enabled a BattleMech to blend more cleanly with the terrain, blurring the 'outline' of a mech with a primitive mimetic system.
